content: Bulus d Silas di Tissaluniki
Ẓwan x Amfipulis d Apulluniya, iwḍen ɣar Tissalunika mani tuɣa ict n temzida n Wudayen.
Bulus yudef-dd din ɣarsen, am tuɣa d lqaɛida nnes. Di třata n wussan n ssebt issiweř akidsen zi Tira Iqeddsen.
Iffessar u issbeyyen asen ammu: “Tuɣa ittxeṣṣa i Lmasiḥ ad ittwaweddeb u ad dd-ikkar zi taddart n imettinen. Aqa Netta d Yasuɛ, Lmasiḥ min xef d awem barrḥeɣ.”
Ca zzaysen umnen, munen ak-d Bulus d Sila, uřa d aṭṭas n Iyunaniyyen inni itteggʷeden AREBBI, uřa d timɣarin icennɛen, war iǧi drust zzaysent,

Maca Udayen dewřen ttasmen, nedhen ca n yeryazen iɛeffanen zeg ibriden n tendint, ssgeɛɛden ijj n řɣaci d ameqqran ɣarsen, sshajan tandint uca ssekkaran ten ḍidd n taddart n Yasun, arzun ad ten sellmen i řɣaci.
Umi war ten ufin din, jarren Yasun d wawmaten i din iǧan ɣar izeǧifen n tendint, sɣuyyun: “Xzar, ina, inni issɣewwɣen tammurt marra, aqa usin-dd ɛawed da!
Yasun issidef i-ten ɣares d inewjiwen, waxxa nitni marra ttɛekksen tiwṣeyyat n qayṣar, qqaren aqa da ajeǧid nneɣni, aqa-t d Yasuɛ.”
Ssarejfen izeǧifen n tendint d řgens umi sřin aya.
Maca awarni řami ṭṭfen řɛarbunat zi Yasun d yinneɣni, arxun asen.
Bulus d Silas di Biriya
Řexdenni ssekken tawmat Bulus d Sila ɣar Biriya s ǧiřet. Umi din iwḍen, ruḥen ɣar temzida n Wudayen,
minzi Udayen dinni tuɣa aten xar zeg inni i yeǧan di Tissalunika, minzi tuɣa xsen ad sřen i Wawař kuř ass, arezzun ad ssnen zi Tira Iqeddsen, ma timesřayin-a aqa tent amenni.
Aṭṭas zzaysen umnen, uřa d aṭṭas n temɣarin d yeryazen zeg Iyunaniyyen.
Maca, umi Udayen n Tissalunika ssnen belli Bulus tuɣa ittbarreḥ Awař n AREBBI di Biriya, usin-dd nitni ɛawed din, war ssbedden zeg usɣewweɣ u zeg usxarweḍ jar imezdaɣ n tendint.
Xas uca jjin wawmaten ad ihwa Bulus řexdenni ɣar řebḥar, maca Sila d Timutiyu qqimen din.
Inni issqebḍen Bulus, iwyen t ɣar tendint n Atina. Xenni, umi t jjin, ṭṭfen zzayes ict n tebrat i Sila d Timutiyu maḥend nitni ad ɣares dd-asen deɣya.
Bulus di Atina
Am ten tuɣa ittraja Bulus di Atina, tuɣa arruḥ nnes ixeyyeq umi iẓra tandint teccur s řexyařat n l’aṣnam.
S uyenni tuɣa issawař di temzida ak-d Wudayen u ak-d yinni itteggʷeden AREBBI, u di ssuq uřa ak-d inni i tuɣa ittmunen dinni kuř ass.

Ɛad ca n ifaylasufen zi temzida n Ipikurus u ca nneɣni, qqaren as Istuwakiyyen, mnaqacen akides. Ca zzaysen nnan: “Min ixs ad yini wanita s řhard-a qaɛ?” Maca inneɣni nnan: “Iḍhar-dd aqa-t d ambarreḥ n irebbiten iɣriben, minzi tuɣa ittbarreḥ asen s Yasuɛ d tnukra nnes zeg imettinen.
Uca iwyen t, nedhen t ɣar řebni n taddart n ccreɛ umi qqaren Ariyupagus, nnan as: “Ma iɛeddeř ad nessen man taɣuri n jdid i tᵉttbarrḥed?”,
minzi cek tiwyed ca n tmesřayin tiɣribin i imezzuɣen nneɣ, u neccin nexs ad nessen min ixs ad yini man aya.”
Marra inni zi Atina d marra ibarraniyyen inni din iqqimen, sseɛdun řweqt mɣir ḥima ad xebbaren u ḥima ad sřen ict n řḥajjet n jdid.
Ikkar-dd Bulus, ibedd di taddart n ccreɛ qqaren as ‘Ariyupagus’, inna: “A iryazen n Atina, ufiɣ belli kenniw tᵉttɛemmarem sennej i ṭṭarf s tiggʷudi n ccwaṭen zi kuř aɣezdis.

Minzi umi nnḍeɣ di tendint nwem, ẓriɣ timzidawin nwem, ufiɣ ɛawed ijj n uɛalṭar zemmen xas: ‘I AREBBI i war ittwassnen’. S uyenni wenni tɛebbdem kenniw, am war t tessinem, d Wa i zi d awem ttbeccareɣ.
Minzi AREBBI wenni dd-yejjin ddunect d marra min dayes, wenni iǧan d Sidi n ujenna d temmurt, war izeddeɣ ca di tzawiyyin i ittwaggen s ifassen n iwdan,
uřa war xas ittwasexxar s ifassen n iwdan axmi Netta iḥwaj ca, minzi Netta simant nnes iwca i mkuř bnadem tudart d twarrit n nnefs.
Zeg idammen n yijjen igga marra řegnus n bnadem ḥima ad zedɣen x wudem n temmurt marra, u s řumur nnes ifarz asen řmijařat n řweqt uca igga iymiren n tzeddiɣt n iwdan,
ḥima ad arzun x AREBBI u ad zzayes ttaren, ad taɣ ad t afen s marra min zzayes ittwaggen, maɣar Netta war iggʷij ca aṭṭas x kuř ijjen zzayneɣ.
Minzi neccin dayes i neddar u dayes i nᵉttenhezza u dayes i neǧa, am mammec nnan ca n imiɣisen nwem: ‘Aqa neqqarṣ zzayes Netta!’
S uyenni, am dd-iqqarṣ bnadem zi AREBBI, ittxeṣṣa war nḥesseb ca belli ureɣ niɣ nnuqart niɣ aẓru i ittwaggen s lfenn u s tzemmar n bnadem, aqa aten am AREBBI i ǧan.
AREBBI ijja ad ɛdunt zzmanat n uweddar, maca řexxu, di zzman-a ittamar i marra iwdan, aqa ittxeṣṣa i kuř bnadem di kuř amcan ad dd-idweř ɣar AREBBI!
Minzi Netta igga ijj n wass i di i ɣa iḥkem x marra tammurt s řḥeqq s ijj n Bnadem i ifarz. Netta igga kuř ijjen ittxeṣṣa as maḥend ad zzayes yamen, řami t-i-dd-issnekkar zi taddart n imettinen.”
Umi sřin x tnukra zi taddart n imettinen, bdan sthezzan s man aya, maca inneɣni nnan: “Ict n twařa nneɣni nexs ad zzayek nseř ktar x man aya.”
Ammu iffeɣ Bulus zi řwesṭ nsen.
Ca zzaysen ḍfaren t, umnen. Tuɣa Diyunisiyus d ijjen zzaysen, aqa-t jar řquḍat n Ariyupagus, uřa d ict n temɣart qqaren as Damaris u inneɣni akidsen. *
